name: Nakushita Toki e
source:
Main character is 28 years and he now returns to his hometown. He is shocked to know that his former lover committed suicide two years ago. He gets into an accident and gains an ability to turn time back. Now he can save his first love or opt for absolutely new acquaintances.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公28岁，如今回到了故乡。得知前恋人在两年前自杀后，他大受震惊。一次事故让他获得了回溯时间的能力。如今，他可以拯救初恋，也可以选择结识全新的人。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
